challenger: Gallery-selected conditional reduction in frame-four weight
motion: Hold pre-cut, advance one step per frame starting on cut. Clear both histories and reset frame counter at the cut. All other movers offstage.
pipeline: Production WebGL2 1280x720, high quality, analytic movers, one-bounce GI, default sun
edge: Visible floor within 10 cm of either long side in plan view, excluding 18 cm at both tips
recovery_roi: Visible floor within 1.1 m lateral and 0.85 m longitudinal of plank center; sample every fourth raster pixel from top-left (2,2)
contact_ref: 1024 deterministic cosine hemisphere Hammersley rays, hard visibility to 1.12 m, origin lifted 0.3 mm; all Archive boxes and moving plank
temporal_ref: Shipping beauty at each identical post-cut pose after 96 fixed-pose frames and fresh history. Display RGB converted to linear Rec.709 luma.
flicker: p95 absolute frame difference in reference-subtracted luma on intersection of consecutive visible floor ROIs; no cross-cut difference
recovery: Mean absolute beauty luma residual per frame; recovery is first of three consecutive frames <=0.005
timing: 6 paired whole-shot blocks alternating order, synchronized beauty frames only, post-cut frames, setup and explicit reset excluded
worst_still: Frame with highest moving-edge AO MAE across either variant, earliest on tie
